terms.issue: Plant closure as a restructuring option
terms.outcome: Unresolved standoff; labor holds an unconditional veto while management insists on forcing a board vote.
Unresolved standoff; management maintains the threat despite unified opposition from state, family, and investors.

terms.issue: Aggregate financial contributions to close the cost gap
terms.outcome: Live proposal range; specific labor, dividend, and state contributions are tabled but untested for overall sufficiency.
Near-agreement range; five parties converge on 36–48 months with a two-checkpoint trigger, while management holds at 30–36 months.
